about.meta.title: About VectraSyn — How We Work, Payment Terms & FAQ
about.meta.description: Who VectraSyn is, our four-step process from discovery to support, our payment terms, and clear answers on pricing, delivery times and post-launch support.
about.heading: A digital studio built around clarity and speed
about.story1: VectraSyn is a digital services studio. We build websites, mobile and web apps, e-commerce stores, automation pipelines and brand identities for small, medium and growing businesses — priced up front, delivered quickly, and explained in language you can act on.
about.story2: The studio was founded by a Make and n8n automation specialist, and that background shapes how we work: we look at a business as a set of connected processes, not a set of disconnected deliverables. A website that quietly feeds your CRM, a store that reconciles its own orders, a form that reaches the right person in seconds — that is the standard we build to.
about.story3: Our approach is deliberately simple. Scope the work honestly, quote a fixed price before anything begins, build in short visible passes, and hand over something you can run yourself. No retainers you did not ask for, no jargon, no surprises at invoice time.
about.story4: What makes us different is the combination: agency-grade delivery with automation thinking baked in, at prices a growing business can plan around. We would rather do a focused set of things properly than sell a package you do not need.
about.process.heading: Four steps, start to finish
about.step1.title: Discover
about.step1.body: A short conversation about your business, your customers and what the project has to achieve. You leave with a fixed price and a timeline.
about.step2.title: Build
about.step2.body: We build in focused passes and share progress as we go, so nothing lands as a surprise at the end.
about.step3.title: Launch
about.step3.body: We handle setup, testing and go-live, then walk you through anything you will manage yourself.
about.step4.title: Support
about.step4.body: Optional monthly maintenance keeps everything current, or come back for one-off changes whenever you need them.
about.hybrid.label: Hybrid working:
about.hybrid.body: we don't yet have a dedicated public office, but we do have a space where we meet clients in person when needed, alongside remote/online work — a genuinely hybrid setup.
about.payment.heading: How payment works
about.payment.intro: The terms below apply to every project.
about.payment.item1.title: Deposit and milestones
about.payment.item1.body: 30% deposit on signing, 40% at the mid-build milestone, 30% on completion and handover.
about.payment.item2.title: Deposit is non-refundable after commitment
about.payment.item2.body: The deposit becomes non-refundable once you have signed the agreement and completed the video consultation appointment. That point marks mutual commitment: your slot is reserved and work begins.
about.payment.item3.title: If we cannot deliver
about.payment.item3.body: If VectraSyn is unable to fulfil the agreed scope, you are refunded 70% of the amount paid.
about.payment.item4.title: Free bug fixes for two months
about.payment.item4.body: The first two months after launch include bug fixes at no additional cost. This covers defects in what we built; new features and scope changes are quoted separately.
about.payment.note: Final terms confirmed at contract signing.
about.faq.heading: Common questions
about.faq.q1: How much does a website cost?
about.faq.a1short: A standalone business website is ₹22,000 in INR, or $350 / AED 1,500, at our current final price.
about.faq.a1long: The list price for the same build is ₹36,000 ($700 / AED 3,000). That covers a mobile-friendly site built, tested and launched for you, without automation. Larger scopes — e-commerce, custom integrations, extra pages — are quoted individually on the pricing page.
about.faq.a2short: Most business websites go live within one to two weeks of the project starting.
about.faq.a2long: Logo design and a single automation pipeline are usually faster, often within a few days. App builds and e-commerce stores take longer and depend on catalogue size and integrations. You receive a specific timeline with your quote, before any work begins.
about.faq.q3: What is included at each pricing tier?
about.faq.a3short: Every service on the pricing page has a 'What's included' list showing exactly what you get.
about.faq.a3long: Website Only is a standalone site with no automation. Bundle 1 adds a 4-page website, one automation connection, logo design and Google Business Profile setup. Bundle 2 adds up to 2 more pages, WhatsApp Business setup, SEO/AEO/GEO setup, GA4 analytics and 100 printed visiting cards with a scan code (Hyderabad-exclusive).
about.faq.a4short: The first two months after launch include free bug fixes, and monthly maintenance is available at ₹8,000 per month.
about.faq.a4long: Bug fixes cover defects in what we built. Maintenance covers updates, fixes and small content or design changes, and is entirely optional. Bundle 1 clients pay ₹3,000 per year for domain and maintenance after year one, and you can always come back for one-off changes.
about.faq.a5short: Projects run on a deposit plus milestone schedule, with the exact percentages confirmed at contract signing.
about.faq.a5long: The deposit becomes non-refundable once you have signed the agreement and completed the video consultation appointment. If VectraSyn cannot fulfil the agreed scope, you are refunded 70% of the amount paid. The first two months after launch include free bug fixes.
about.faq.q6: How does the e-commerce or WooCommerce quote process work?
about.faq.a6short: E-commerce is priced as a custom quote, starting from ₹30,000–₹80,000 ($1,200–$3,000 / AED 4,500–12,000).
about.faq.a6long: We start with a scoping call covering catalogue size, payment gateway, shipping and tax rules, and any integrations. You then receive a fixed written quote within that range, or above it if the scope is unusually large. Nothing is charged until you accept the quote.
about.faq.q7: Which industries do you work with?
about.faq.a7short: We work with local services, retail and e-commerce, clinics and consultants, hospitality, trades and contractors, and education and training.
about.faq.a7long: The work is not industry-specific — the same core needs apply across sectors. If your business falls outside these categories, the discovery call is the fastest way to confirm we are a good fit.
about.faq.q8: What technology and hosting do you use?
about.faq.a8short: Our sites are built on a modern React-based stack, with domains managed through Cloudflare and hosting on Vercel.
about.faq.a8long: Our sites are built on a modern React-based stack via our development platform, and can be extended with other languages/frameworks as a project needs. Domains are managed through Cloudflare, with hosting on Vercel. E-commerce projects are typically built on WooCommerce, and automation runs on Make or n8n.
about.faq.q9: How many rounds of revisions are included?
about.faq.a9short: Revisions within the agreed scope are included during the build, at each review pass.
about.faq.a9long: We build in short passes and share progress as we go, so feedback is applied continuously rather than saved for one final review. Changes that expand the agreed scope — new pages, new features, a new direction after sign-off — are quoted separately before work continues.
about.faq.q10: What do you need from me to get started?
about.faq.a10short: A short description of your business and what you want the project to achieve.
about.faq.a10long: Anything you already have helps — logo files, photos, product data, text, or links to sites you like. If none of that exists yet, we work through it together during discovery.
about.faq.q11: Do you work with businesses outside India?
about.faq.a11short: Yes — we work remotely and quote in INR, USD and AED.
about.faq.a11long: Communication runs over email and video calls, scheduled around your time zone. Payment gateway and hosting choices are adjusted to your market during scoping.
about.faq.q12: Can you automate the tools we already use?
about.faq.a12short: Yes — a Simple Pipeline connects your site, social channel or form to Google Sheets or Airtable as one connection.
about.faq.a12long: It is priced at ₹5,000 ($100 / AED 400) and includes field mapping and a live test run before handover. Additional connections and multi-step workflows are scoped and quoted separately.
